name: amazon-dashboard
description: Amazon Seller/Vendor Central dashboard — upload raw reports, store by date, view DSR / DUR.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "cd apps/api && bun run dev" "cd apps/web && bun run dev"
scripts.build: cd apps/api && bun run build && cd ../web && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: cd packages/shared && bun run typecheck && cd ../../apps/api && bun run typecheck && cd ../web && bun run typecheck
